components.text: The ’Brand Equity Matrix’ allows commercial teams to assess the equity of their brand and all relevant competitor brands in a therapeutic area which can be monitored across the lifecycle of a brand and continually referenced to help inform commercial strategies

GROWTH STARS

Brands with high utility and high reputation 

E.g.: Brands that have been around for a while (to have gained good reputation) and are expected to further grow in use

SUNRISE

Brands with promising utility but not a great reputation yet

E.g.: Recently launched brands (and hence low reputation) where HCPs see great potential for growth

SUNSET

Brands with good reputation but lower utility

E.g.: Established brands that have reached their maximum potential and cannot grow further

CLOUDS

Brands with low utility and low reputation 

E.g.: “Me-too” brands that HCPs don’t know much about

Net Promoter Score

The Net Promoter Score (NPS) is an index used to gauge customer loyalty to a product. It ranges from -100 to 100 and is calculated by subtracting the percentage of respondents who rate 0-6 (detractors) from the percentage who rate 9-10 (promoters)
The Net Promoter Score captures physician’s likelihood to recommend a product to a colleague when clinically appropriate
